AMSC.physical_anchor: Makes grid-interconnection power electronics (D-VAR reactive power compensators, superconductor cable systems) and licensed wind-turbine electrical control systems.
AMSC.value_chain_position: Power management & connectors / protective grid-interconnection equipment layer — sells reactive-power compensation and superconductor-based grid hardware plus licensed wind ECS.

ANET.physical_anchor: Makes high-speed Ethernet switches and routers for cloud/AI-datacenter networking.
ANET.value_chain_position: Networking hardware for datacenter compute fabric — adjacent to, but not part of, any FDT power/quantum/robotics chain in this taxonomy.

AOS.physical_anchor: Makes residential and commercial water heaters and boilers.
AOS.value_chain_position: Water-heating/boiler equipment maker — no genuine tie to grid, nuclear, power-for-AI, robotics or quantum chains despite the Industrial-Machinery filter hit.

APG.physical_anchor: Provides fire, life-safety and specialty electrical/mechanical contracting services — a services business, not a manufacturer.
APG.value_chain_position: Fire/life-safety and specialty infrastructure services contractor — not grid-EPC-specific despite the Engineering & Construction filter hit.

APH.physical_anchor: Makes electrical, electronic and fiber-optic connectors and interconnect systems sold across IT/datacom, industrial, auto, mobile and defense end markets.
APH.value_chain_position: Diversified interconnect component supplier — touches many chains' supply chains at low, non-attributable intensity rather than genuinely riding any single one.

APP.physical_anchor: None — AppLovin is an AI-driven mobile advertising and app-monetization software platform with no physical product.
APP.value_chain_position: Ad-tech / app-monetization software — outside the physical value chain entirely (anti-Visa case).

APPF.physical_anchor: None — AppFolio is property-management SaaS software.
APPF.value_chain_position: Vertical SaaS for real-estate property managers — no physical anchor, no chain tie.

ARM.physical_anchor: None — Arm licenses CPU/GPU core IP architectures; it manufactures no physical chips itself.
ARM.value_chain_position: Semiconductor IP licensor — the payments-network analog; downstream licensees (Apple, Qualcomm, Nvidia) fabricate the physical chips.

ASML.physical_anchor: Makes EUV and DUV photolithography systems for semiconductor fabs.
ASML.value_chain_position: Leading-edge lithography equipment for general semiconductor manufacturing — real physical anchor but not quantum-specific; a generic-semis false hit on the quantum filter.

ASX.physical_anchor: Provides semiconductor assembly, packaging and test (OSAT) services.
ASX.value_chain_position: OSAT packaging/test for the general chip industry — physical but not quantum-specific.

ATEN.physical_anchor: Makes application-delivery-controller and DDoS-protection network appliances.
ATEN.value_chain_position: Network security/traffic-management appliances — no quantum tie despite the Software-Infrastructure filter hit.

ATR.physical_anchor: Makes dispensing pumps, closures and drug-delivery devices for pharma, beauty and food packaging.
ATR.value_chain_position: Precision dispensing/packaging hardware — unrelated to any FDT chain despite the Medical-Instruments filter hit pulling it into the robotics screen.

ATRC.physical_anchor: Makes cardiac ablation devices and surgical clips (AtriClip) for AFib treatment — hand-held/minimally-invasive instruments, not a robotic surgical platform.
ATRC.value_chain_position: Cardiac-surgery device maker — adjacent to but not itself surgical robotics; ISRG-class platforms are the genuine chain member.

ATRO.physical_anchor: Makes aircraft cabin power systems, lighting and electrical connectors, plus aerospace test equipment.
ATRO.value_chain_position: Aerospace electrical-systems supplier — no nuclear tie; caught by the broad Aerospace & Defense industry string shared with BWXT.

AVGO.physical_anchor: Makes networking/AI ASICs, RF and broadband semiconductors.
AVGO.value_chain_position: General AI/networking silicon — real chips, but not quantum-hardware-specific; a large-cap-semis false hit on the quantum filter.

AVPT.physical_anchor: None — AvePoint is data-governance/management SaaS for Microsoft 365 environments.
AVPT.value_chain_position: Enterprise SaaS — no physical anchor, no chain tie.

BB.physical_anchor: None — BlackBerry sells QNX embedded operating-system software and cybersecurity software; it manufactures no hardware.
BB.value_chain_position: Embedded-software/cybersecurity vendor — no chain tie despite the Software-Infrastructure filter hit.

BE.physical_anchor: Makes solid-oxide fuel cell power-generation systems (Energy Servers) deployed on-site to power datacenters and commercial customers.
BE.value_chain_position: Behind-the-meter distributed power generation — sells firm on-site fuel-cell electrons directly into the datacenter power-delivery queue (power_for_ai) and grid-independent electrification capacity (electrification_grid).

BELFB.physical_anchor: Makes electronic connectors, power modules and magnetics for networking, aerospace/defense and industrial electronics.
BELFB.value_chain_position: Diversified electronic-component supplier — too generalized across end markets to genuinely ride any single FDT chain.

BIO.physical_anchor: Makes life-science research instruments (chromatography, PCR/ddPCR systems) and clinical-diagnostics quality-control products.
BIO.value_chain_position: Lab instrumentation/diagnostics — not a surgical-robotics or automation platform despite the Medical-Devices filter hit.
